Terraces

Measured from the front of both houses. Adjusts from 1 to 8 m, starting at 3 m. The terrace cover resizes, and the pool deck and steps move with its front edge.

The terrace between the houses starts at 8 m. Its covered connection grows or narrows as B moves; the pool deck follows B. The rear margin starts at 2 m and can vary from 1 to 4 m. Left and right side margins adjust separately from 2 to 4 m. The rear edge follows B's main rear wall, leaving A another 0.2 m. Tier spacing for the brown guides farther uphill adjusts from 1 to 4 m.

Shadows

Uses the 15th of the selected month and local Sicily time (CET / CEST). The slider stays within daylight hours, in 15-minute steps.

Shadows use the modeled terrain, houses, covered terraces and pool levels. Tree canopies and distant hills are not modeled. Choose Shaded terrain for the clearest view of shadows.

Possible rear terrace guide

Rear lines lie on existing ground at the selected 1 to 4 m spacing, with a nominal 1.1 m rise used to stop the sequence. They suggest space for small terraces; they do not depict finished walls or an excavated surface.

Brown vertical platform edges show the gap to existing ground. They are cut or support faces, not a proposal for a single retaining wall.

Geometry and assumptions

A: 13 × 6.8 m. B: 17.5 × 7 m plus a 4 × 5 m rear wing. The clear gap starts at 8 m and is adjustable from 2 to 16 m, with a covered terrace connection. Roof edges: about 3.4–4.5 m; roof junctions are indicative.

The upper terrace starts 42.5 m wide, with 3 m in front and nominal 2 m rear and side margins. The front depth adjusts from 1 to 8 m, including its cover, with the pool deck and steps following its edge. The rear margin adjusts from 1 to 4 m; left and right side margins adjust independently from 2 to 4 m. Pool water starts at 12 × 4.5 m and remains 1.4 m deep as its length and width change. Lounge defaults are 0 m downhill, 3 m toward the house, 6 m left and 3.5 m right; each is adjustable. Steps move with the deck and can slide from left to right, avoiding the water. Their width starts at 2 m and can vary from 1 to 6 m, with 0.3 m treads. A 0 m pool deck drop needs no steps.

Pool freeboard, coping, shell thickness and foundations are not specified. Water and deck share a provisional datum; the basin floor is 1.4 m below it.

Terrain and quantities

Original Sicilian MDT 2013, 2 m grid; no field-based correction has been applied. The 2022 aerial photograph and tree positions are regional imagery and manual markers.

The source bitmap is unchanged. This model cuts the visible terrain only under proposed platforms. The study's quantities are geometric cut / fill-or-support proxies, excluding finished banks, walls, drainage, foundations and structural allowances. Front voids can represent raised construction rather than imported fill.

True horizontal and vertical scale. Local measurements around a shortlisted layout will refine floor and terrace levels.
